summary: Unchanged; about one minute remains, so no further work is attempted. The run may expire on this record, which is complete: three receipt-backed defects — unbound leadership-transfer acceptance (no term, sender-identity or membership check, and the order suppresses pre-vote and the known-leader vote rejection), the constant-zero `GetConfiguration().Index()` defeating the documented `prevIndex` guard, and repeated identical automatic snapshots on a snapshot-recovered idle node with a control — plus one conditional finding (deprecated voter-only peer encoding on a below-protocol-2 leader after a rollback-style restart) and a body of sourced behaviours with explicit limits and two flagged unresolved boundaries.
